case.input_prompt: Audit internal policy document SOC2-SEC-09 and extract clause SOC2-SEC-09-A.

Maintains exact compliance audit reporting style.

trace.final_output: Audit record for policy SOC2-SEC-09: Clause SOC2-SEC-09-A stipulates that multi-factor authentication (MFA) is strictly required for all administrative SSH access to production infrastructure.
